name: Metalcraft Images
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to generate, edit, and inspect images via Metalcraft Images (images.metalcraftai.com), billed in the user's Metalcraft credits. List the image models and their per-image price (mimg_list_models), generate from a prompt (mimg_generate_image), edit an existing image (mimg_edit_image) using a gallery image, an uploaded local file (mimg_upload_image), or a URL, ask a vision model what is actually in an image (mimg_describe_image), mint a shareable link (mimg_share_image), and browse history (mimg_list_generations, mimg_get_generation). Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. Generating, editing, and describing are premium-only and each spends the caller's Metalcraft credits.
